forum.title: Timer triggered DMA Memory to GPIO output on the STM32G070RB
forum.best_answer_content:
This can't be done. The GPIO ports are not accessible to the DMA on the STM32G0x0.

![Screenshot 2026-03-13 090805.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/98d829e5-7227-1015-eaa0-648725e35665.png "Screenshot 2026-03-13 090805.png")
